henry.title: The Three Sisters: How Ancient Farmers Grew Food in the Desert
henry.intro: About 800 years ago, Ancestral Pueblo people farmed in the canyons of northern New Mexico, where it hardly rains. They grew corn, beans and squash together, called the 'Three Sisters'. Today you'll find out how they did it. (About 12 minutes.)
steps: FIRST: open the 'Three Sisters' page (link 1). Read the part that starts 'Corn serves as a trellis'. You'll see how each plant helps the others. Answer questions 1 and 2.
NEXT: open the 'Ancestral Pueblo Farming' page (link 2). Scroll to the paragraph about rain and water. Find the words pumice, digging stick, and scattering plots. Answer questions 3, 4 and 5.
LAST: draw your garden (question 6). You're done when all 6 answers are filled in!
Word help: trellis = something a plant climbs on. mulch = a cover on the dirt that keeps water in. plot = a small patch of garden.
worksheet:
Match each sister to its job (draw a line): Corn • • adds food to the soil
Beans • • a pole for beans to climb
Squash • • big leaves shade the ground
Pumice is a rock that acts like a ________. Why did farmers put it on their gardens? (Hint: water!)
What tool did they use to plant seeds? ________
Why did they plant lots of small gardens in different places instead of one big one? (Example start: 'If one garden dried up...')
Draw a Three Sisters garden. Label the corn, the beans climbing it, and the squash on the ground.
links: Read the paragraph about how corn, beans and squash help each other.
Look at the photo, then find pumice, digging stick, and scattering plots.

frankie.title: The Three Sisters Garden 🌽
frankie.intro: Grown-up, read aloud: Long ago, families in New Mexico grew three plants together, like three sisters helping each other: corn 🌽, beans 🫘 and squash 🎃. (About 10 minutes.)
steps: Grown-up: print the coloring page (link) or show it on the screen.
Point to each plant together: tall corn, beans climbing up, squash on the ground.
Frankie colors the page, then does the worksheet. Done!
worksheet: Color the tall one green 🌽 and draw beans climbing up it.
Draw you and your family picking food.
links: NPS: Three Sisters coloring page (printable PDF)
Print it and color the corn, beans and squash.
